text.description_html:
Commercial 4" x 4" x Square Corners Single Action Spring Hinge

Packaged completed with One Single Action Spring Door Hinge, Allen Adjusting Wrench, Locking Pins, plus #12 x 1-1/4" Wood Screws and #12- x 1/2" Machine Screws. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

UL Listed (R18063) Fired Rated. The included Allen Wrench Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pin holds the Spring in tension after it is set.

Specifications: for Commercial Spring Door Hinge

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square Corners
  • Thickness: 0.129"
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • UL Listed, Fire Rated
  • Available Finishes: 5

*Sold Individually.
